concept: CloudWatch agent + Logs Insights: centralized logs and queries
tests: How to centralize logs from many EC2 instances and query them for troubleshooting with minimal overhead.
expected: Install the CloudWatch agent → ship logs to CloudWatch Logs → query interactively with Logs Insights. Triggers: "centralize logs from many EC2", "run queries to troubleshoot", "LEAST operational overhead".
why_not: Manual copying to S3 and email is overhead and slow; logs kept only on instances are lost when they're replaced.
